profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer in Test / SDET · AI Quality Engineer | Agentic & Multi-Agent Systems Testing, LLM Evals, Guardrails | Quality Platform · MCP · AI Observability
profile.summary:
I build the quality platform that ships software, and the AI agents that test it.

I architected my current employer's first multi-agent system on Claude (Anthropic) Managed Agents: a coordinator handles agent orchestration across four least-privilege specialist agents that plan test coverage, write Playwright E2E specs, run them against the pull request's live review app, security-review the diff, and open a draft PR - unattended, from GitHub trigger to review. Its sibling system diagnoses and repairs flaky and failing end-to-end tests straight from CI. Engineers on other product teams adopted both within a month.

Making that safe was most of the work. I own the Python/FastAPI control plane on Kubernetes that brokers every agent action: signed GitHub webhooks, exactly-once run claiming, and one authorization checkpoint that refuses any write not backed by a passing test run and a clean security verdict - so the agents never hold write credentials. I authored the threat model reviewed by Security, layered deny-by-default egress, moved execution of agent-written code into ephemeral Kubernetes Jobs that hold no credentials, and added spend caps, kill switches, LLM evals for these non-deterministic systems, and Datadog dashboards on per-agent cost, coverage gaps, and stalled runs. Every agent prompt and skill ships as version-pinned config in Git, so behavior changes by pull request and code review, never by console click.

Underneath that is 12+ years as an SDET (Software Engineer in Test) building test automation for SaaS and fintech. I built the Playwright/TypeScript E2E framework across 10+ application modules, migrated CI/CD from GitLab CI to GitHub Actions with parallel test sharding (60%+ faster suites; ~95 required smoke tests blocking every PR across 5 shards), and built Datadog-powered flaky-test intelligence that auto-quarantines and reports weekly to Slack, cutting false failures ~30%. Before that I built Cypress, Selenium, and Cucumber frameworks at MAXEX and led a 20-person QA team at Hexaware.

What I work with: TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Playwright, Cypress, RSpec, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Datadog observability, Claude API and Managed Agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), agentic AI, prompt engineering, LLM evals, guardrails.

Open to Senior/Staff Software Developer Engineer (Test), Lead/Manager Engineer in Test, Quality Platform, and AI agent infrastructure roles - remote US or Atlanta. Best way to reach me: luis.flores.serna@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Quality) / SDET, Platform Quality Engineering
positions.description:
I build and operate Ontra's autonomous multi-agent QA platform - AI agents that plan, write, run, and security-review tests on every pull request. Adopted by other product teams within a month.

- Architected Ontra's first multi-agent system on Claude (Anthropic) Managed Agents: a coordinator drives four least-privilege agents that plan coverage, write Playwright tests, run them, security-review the diff, and open a draft PR.
- Built the Python/FastAPI control plane on Kubernetes that brokers every agent action: signed GitHub webhooks, exactly-once run claiming, and a checkpoint that blocks any write without a passing test run.
- Owned the security architecture: authored the threat model reviewed by Security (12 threats, every pre-launch High closed) and put deny-by-default egress around the agents, their web tools, and the Kubernetes namespace.
- Moved agent-written test code into ephemeral Kubernetes Jobs holding no GitHub, Anthropic, or secrets-manager credentials, so untrusted generated code runs sandboxed and credential-free.
- Cut a full pipeline run from 66 to 49 minutes and per-run cost by about a quarter via per-phase instrumentation, prompt caching, and an eval-gated A/B on model effort.
- Added per-run spend caps, kill switches, and Datadog alerts on per-agent cost, coverage gaps, and stalled runs; every prompt and skill is version-pinned in Git, so behavior changes by pull request.
- Published seven reusable Claude Code skills (QA planning, test authoring, test review, CI-failure repair) and MCP integrations for Playwright, Jira, and Notion; engineers author new tests in about half the time.
- Led the three-engineer platform workstream with Infrastructure and Security, including the build-vs-buy call across Managed Agents, self-hosted, and AWS Bedrock AgentCore, plus the operator runbooks.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Built Ontra's end-to-end test automation platform and the CI/CD pipeline that runs it as a blocking gate on every pull request.

- Designed and built the Playwright/TypeScript E2E framework using Page Object Model and functional patterns, covering 10+ application modules.
- Migrated CI from GitLab CI to GitHub Actions with parallel test sharding, cutting suite execution time by over 60%, and made ~95 required smoke tests a blocking PR check across 5 shards.
- Built Datadog-powered flaky-test detection that auto-quarantines flaky tests and reports them weekly in Slack, cutting false failures ~30%, with GitHub Pages dashboards and S3-hosted Playwright reports for release quality metrics.
- Created a tag-based test organization system (smoke, regression, flaky, team-specific) across 8+ product team domains, unified test fixtures, and added API-based test data teardown to cut maintenance overhead.
- Shipped Ruby on Rails services for inbound email processing and document origination, Postman API conformance tests for SCIM provisioning, and React/Ember.js fixes to make the app more testable.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
- Built automation frameworks from the ground up for functional, regression, API, and end-to-end testing using Cypress, Selenium, Cucumber, and SoapUI in TypeScript, Ruby, and Java.
- Integrated automated testing into CI/CD pipelines with AWS services, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins, moving releases from monthly to bi-weekly.
- Served as test-strategy SME across product teams and drove Cypress and modern CI/CD adoption org-wide, cutting production defects over 40%; mentored QA engineers and raised automated coverage of core flows from 45% to 80%.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
- Led an offsite team of 20 QA professionals delivering unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing in an Agile environment.
- Built Selenium/Java/Cucumber UI automation and ETL/SQL data-validation suites.
